budget_items.topic: Library state aid cut and waiver threshold (Article 4)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library presenters said their cut was more than 10% and disproportional, which would require a waiver application for state aid; they said they did not have the figure needed to reach under a 10% cut.
budget_items.quote: because it was more than 10% and because it was disproportional to previous year decreases, they would have to complete a calculation spreadsheet

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager was asked to explain a 123 thousand dollar increase in state aid above the original forecast, and she resisted committing those funds to any project.
budget_items.quote: the town manager was called upon to bring clarity to a 123 thousand dollar increase in our state aid figure

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A library trustee said the library would need an additional amount in funding under the warrant article to avoid seeking a waiver.
budget_items.quote: a trustee of the library stepped forward to state that they would need to receive an additional $35,598.00 in funding

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The BOS chair said the potential financial impact to the town lies between the printed amounts over 20 years.
budget_items.quote: the potential financial impact for the town lies somewhere between 140-180 thousand dollars or approximately 3.6-8.4 million over the next 20 years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager cited the last five years of tuition assessments and variances; the Town Accountant said past overages were covered by unexpended funds.
budget_items.quote: the town accountant answered that those cost had been covered by unexpended funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Asked whether tax revenues would be lost under the PILOT proposals, the answer was yes, subject to negotiation under the net metering agreements.
budget_items.quote: the answer was yes, there would be a forfeiture of tax revenues under the pilots

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member asked whether property might be removed from the state cherry sheets and money lost; the chair of the BOS said property valuations were minimal compared with the potential income.
budget_items.quote: was going to be subject to removal from the state cherry sheets and if we would be losing out on any monies in that regard.
